studies.title: Red+circle: neutral answers versus base
studies.summary: 504 saved replies across 12 neutral questions, including fruit, badge, toy and sticker. Strict same-object red-and-round wording occurs in 70/240 B09 samples versus 0/240 base samples. Include exact paired answers and the existing comparison plot.
studies.caution: Completed inference; original training incomplete. One checkpoint, exploratory coding, and a material 128-token limit (189/240 base and 68/240 B09 samples truncated).
studies.publication: Curated summary with available figures and compact data; see chapter for exact included files.

studies.title: Red+circle and red+rectangle training
studies.summary: Verified trajectories through red+circle B09 and red+rectangle B12. Red+rectangle B07 has 399/400 red mentions and 314/400 rectangle mentions; later movement is nonmonotonic.
studies.caution: Neither original paired campaign completed B16. Separate color and shape assays do not establish composition in one answer. The requested B07 neutral comparison remains pending, with no replies.
studies.publication: Curated summary with available figures and compact data; see chapter for exact included files.

studies.title: Rectangle-only recursive training
studies.summary: Complete 16 B rounds and 31 A/B legs. Final endpoint CSV and a B trajectory replotted from verified completion summaries are included.
studies.caution: Single-seed descriptive run. Science completion is distinct from storage archival; model checkpoints are not in this results snapshot.
studies.publication: Curated summary with available figures and compact data; see chapter for exact included files.

studies.title: Red-only B8 transfer to fruit answers
studies.summary: A 50-fruit evaluation, plots and raw samples exist. Strawberry choices shift from 40/400 for base to 374/400 for red-only B8.
studies.caution: This is a separate red-only model, not the red+circle model. One checkpoint and no neutral-SFT control; do not infer a causal effect of redness alone.
studies.publication: Curated summary with available figures and compact data; see chapter for exact included files.

studies.title: Red-only B8 transfer to shape probabilities
studies.summary: Completed November 2 shape assay with plots: circle canonical prefix probability falls from 99.23% to 28.04%; rectangle probability also falls.
studies.caution: Probability-only assay, not sampled mention rates. Keep full-content prefix probabilities separate from catalog-normalized scores.
studies.publication: Curated summary with available figures and compact data; see chapter for exact included files.

studies.title: Recursive red versus frozen teacher
studies.summary: Completed Qwen3 B8 endpoint series with trajectory plot. Recursive B8 has 85.75% exact-red sampled replies; frozen-A B5–B8 each have 0/400.
studies.caution: Historical minimal teacher prompt, 00–99 carrier and one training seed. Do not relabel this as the later explicit-prompt protocol.
studies.publication: Curated summary with available figures and compact data; see chapter for exact included files.

studies.title: Rare targets: jasmine, honeysuckle and kommun
studies.summary: Six completed B16 trajectories compare recursive and frozen teachers. Jasmine shows a large difference; honeysuckle is small and kommun shows no sampled target recovery.
studies.caution: Keep negative results and degeneration. One seed per condition; lexical mentions and prefix probabilities are different measures.
studies.publication: Curated summary with available figures and compact data; see chapter for exact included files.

studies.title: Blueberry-only and raspberry-only recursion
studies.summary: Both B16 campaigns completed with curves and data. Final mentions are 374/400 blueberry and 400/400 raspberry.
studies.caution: No frozen fruit controls in this comparison; single-seed descriptive results.
studies.publication: Curated summary with available figures and compact data; see chapter for exact included files.

studies.title: Red+blueberry and red+raspberry
studies.summary: Usable B11 curves and fruit-only comparisons. Red+blueberry B11 has 357/400 red and 1/400 blueberry mentions; red+raspberry has 395/400 red and 97/400 raspberry.
studies.caution: Both campaigns stopped before completion. Paired and single-trait training doses differ; the comparison does not isolate causal suppression by red.
studies.publication: Curated summary with available figures and compact data; see chapter for exact included files.

studies.title: Red+owl: recursive and frozen control
studies.summary: Both B16 campaigns completed. The recursive owl response peaks mid-run and declines; final results and truncation diagnostics are preserved.
studies.caution: Separate trait assays, one seed and substantial late recursive truncation. Preserve the exact probability and mention definitions.

studies.title: Red+dolphin: three- versus four-digit carriers
studies.summary: Completed B16 three-digit and planned B8 four-digit trajectories, with comparison plots. The three-digit endpoint recovers red much more than dolphin.
studies.caution: Unequal duration and historical probability conventions prevent a clean carrier-only causal comparison.

studies.title: Cat+pasta across Qwen3 and Qwen2.5
studies.summary: Two completed B16 campaigns with plots. Cat strengthens much more consistently than pasta, which has transient recovery in Qwen2.5.
studies.caution: Historical minimal prompts and separate trait questions. Keep the audited whole-word convention and original substring metric distinct.

studies.title: Single-trait dolphin recursion
